_comment: Ranged's power engine (docs/skills.md 3.4). Provisional: one tip per humour gem, names and numbers to be tuned. Each tip makes a tipped version of every plain ammunition of the kinds it fits ('copper_arrow.garnet'), tipped by using the tips on the ammunition. chance is the percent a landed shot sets it off; chanceCalibrated is added at full calibration.

effect.name: Bloodletting
effect.message: Your garnet tip drinks deep, and you feel it in your own veins.

effect.name: Flare
effect.message: The amber tip bursts in a spray of yellow bile!

effect.name: Stillness
effect.message: The jet tip goes in cold. Your target stiffens.
